error_handling.intent: Error handling hygiene: production code paths must not use bare unwrap()/expect() without context; tests and example code are exempt

bare_panic.instructions: Does this file contain bare unwrap()/expect()/panic!() in production code paths where a handled error or a context message is expected?

criteria.true: A production call site panics on a failure mode that callers could reasonably handle (I/O, parsing, locking), with no context about why
criteria.false: The call site is in test/example code, the invariant is locally provable (const/known-good literal), or the error carries a context message and a comment justifying the panic

panic_severity.instructions: How risky is the panicking call site if the failure mode triggers at runtime?
criteria: Safe: provable invariant or non-production path
Risky: reachable at runtime under plausible input; service would crash on user data
Critical: reachable on the main request/startup path; a malformed input takes the whole process down

docs_tone.intent: Docs hygiene: user-facing markdown must not contain placeholder sections (TBD, TODO, lorem ipsum) and should read as tutorial or reference

doc_state.instructions: Classify this markdown document's readiness for users.

criteria.finished: Every section has real content; no placeholder markers remain
criteria.draft: Real content overall, but clearly marked draft sections or TODO notes for missing parts
criteria.placeholder: Mostly skeleton: TBD/TODO/lorem-ipsum body, headings without content
criteria.not_docs: The file is not user-facing documentation (changelog scratch, meeting notes, generated file)
